H06-pos1.label: violation
H06-pos1.note: The controller rejects Sunday bookings, a clinic-hours rule that belongs in the domain or a use case.

H06-pos2.label: violation
H06-pos2.note: The vendor gateway rejects claims under a minimum amount locally instead of leaving that decision to the core.

H06-twin1.label: clean
H06-twin1.note: The controller only checks that startsAt is a parseable date, a transport-shape check.

H06-twin2.label: clean
H06-twin2.note: The gateway only guards the request's technical shape (integer amount, non-empty policy number).

H06-legit.label: clean
H06-legit.note: The Sunday rule lives in the Appointment entity and the controller only maps the domain error to HTTP 422.

H08-pos1.label: violation
H08-pos1.note: The use case pulls its notifier from a static registry at run time instead of the constructor.

H08-pos2.label: violation
H08-pos2.note: The controller obtains the booking port through a helper that looks it up in the static registry.

H08-twin1.label: clean
H08-twin1.note: A registry exists but is read only in main.ts, the composition root; the use case receives the notifier by constructor.

H08-twin2.label: clean
H08-twin2.note: The use case picks a notifier from a channel map that is injected through its constructor.

H08-legit.label: clean
H08-legit.note: The use case calls a static factory on a domain entity, which creates a domain object and is not a dependency lookup.

H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The domain RejectionReason union copies the vendor's decline codes verbatim.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: The port declares an enum whose members and values copy the vendor's precision codes.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: The domain adds its own rejection categories with its own vocabulary.

H11-twin2.label: clean
H11-twin2.note: The port enum uses the core's own precision terms and the adapter translates the vendor codes into them.

H11-legit.label: clean
